SELECT mf.mf_num AS mfNum, mf.user_num AS userNum, mf.mk_num AS mkNum, mf.mf_name AS mfName,
ml.mk_image AS mkImage, ml.mk_meal_type AS mkMealType,
IFNULL(SUM(md.md_kcal), 0) AS totalKcal,
GROUP_CONCAT(f.fo_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS foodListStr
FROM meal_favorites mf JOIN meal_log ml ON mf.mk_num = ml.mk_num JOIN meal_detail md ON ml.mk_num = md.mk_num JOIN food f ON md.fo_num = f.fo_num
WHERE mf.user_num = #{userNum}
GROUP BY mf.mf_num, mf.user_num, mf.mk_num, mf.mf_name, ml.mk_image, ml.mk_meal_type
ORDER BY mf.mf_num DESC
